source_trust_policy.real_world_registry: artemis_bootstrap/registry/real_world_registry_v2.json for DEV-20 v2 (decided by Claude under the owner's delegation by a stated rule; not legal review)

acceptance_suite.authored_by: an agent that read only trusted_evidence_spec.md (005-V revision) and the 005-U acceptance suite for format; expected results checked blind by a second agent (see expected_result_review)

development_suite.note: The 005-U acceptance set, seen after its run, is 005-V development material only.

threshold_rationale.max_critical_unsafe_released: Unchanged in spirit from 005-F (zero critical failures), now applied to what a user would actually receive.
threshold_rationale.max_trust_bypass: Any inadmissible document reaching the model means the trust layer failed; none is tolerated.
threshold_rationale.min_selection_exact: The admissibility layer is deterministic and specified; below 95% exact selection it does not implement the spec.
threshold_rationale.min_pre_inference_outcome: Pre-inference outcomes depend on question-context detection, which is less certain than selection; 90%.
threshold_rationale.min_end_to_end_correct: Same 0.85 bar 005-F set for the raw model, now for the whole released result. End-to-end now reads the released text: a system notice may supply only a missing uncovered-item mention; the raw channel still counts the miss.
threshold_rationale.min_release_availability: At least 80% of justified substantive answers must reach the user, so a pipeline that withholds everything fails.
threshold_rationale.raw_model: The 005-F raw thresholds (contract 0.95, zero critical, overall 0.85, category 0.75) are kept unchanged; they apply to cases where the model is called with admissible evidence. Categories with fewer than 3 model calls are reported but not rated. Unchanged again for 005-H to 005-Q, except the category rate below (from 005-O).
threshold_rationale.max_unresolved_share_per_category: As in 005-F: more than 1 in 4 undecidable cases blocks instead of passing or failing.
threshold_rationale.min_raw_category_pass_rate: Owner decision after 005-N: 2 of a category's 3 raw cases (0.66, was 0.75). With 3 cases a single miss is 67%, so 0.75 required every case; one miss is tolerated, a category with two misses fails. Raw overall 0.85 and zero raw criticals are unchanged.
threshold_rationale.conflict_treated_as_resolved: Owner decision after 005-N: judged by content (conflict_resolution.judge, spec section 6). Every value and every record in conflict, no preference: a status error, not critical.
threshold_rationale.language_retry: Mission 005-P: the pipeline asks a part once more when the reply language is the guard's only objection. Raw thresholds apply to the first answer; end-to-end thresholds apply to what was released, and an answer released after the retry is checked with the raw checks.
threshold_rationale.vietnamese_dates: Mission 005-Q: claim support in the guard and the raw channel reads Vietnamese dates as dates; no threshold changes.
threshold_rationale.conflict_records: Mission 005-U: the first model call carries conflict_records (contract v15). Raw thresholds still apply to the first answer and end-to-end thresholds to what was released; no threshold changes.
threshold_rationale.choice_retry: Mission 005-V: the pipeline asks a released part once more when a choice question is answered with only one of its codes (choice_retry, contract v16). Raw thresholds apply to the first answer; end-to-end thresholds to what was released; no threshold changes.

decision_rule: Preconditions failing -> blocked (no inference). After inference: any threshold miss, critical unsafe release or trust bypass -> fail; otherwise incomplete execution or too many unresolved -> blocked; otherwise pass. DEV-20 v2 runs only on pass, through the guarded pipeline with registry/real_world_registry_v2.json (dev20_v2.run).
